# GRUB defaults snapshot for restore drill
# This file mirrors /etc/default/grub for the boot configuration package.

GRUB_DEFAULT=0
GRUB_TIMEOUT=5
GRUB_DISTRIBUTOR="Ubuntu"
GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="quiet splash apparmor=1"
GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=""
GRUB_TERMINAL=console
GRUB_ECHO="[\x1b[0m${msg}[\x1b[0m]"
GRUB_DISABLE_RECOVERY=true
GRUB_GFXMODE=auto
GRUB_GFXPAYLOAD_LINUX=keep

# Restore drill notes
# 1. The package should contain only this snapshot and the README.
# 2. Do not edit the snapshot after packaging.
# 3. The update_grub script must be run after the folder is created.
